'''Mos Eisley Biolab''' was a biotechnology company based in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
{{Quote|This is Derg Prantis and it may very well may be my last recording. I've barricaded myself in the biolab hoping to buy some time while I contact the authorities but someone is jamming my comm-signal.|Derg Prantis|<ref name="SWG:BJE" />}}
The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] biologist [[Derg Prantis]] served as chief scientist and one of his employees was the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] lab assistant [[Bera Jeza]].<ref name="SWG:BJE" /> By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Derg Prantis obtained a sample of the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scientist. Prantis therefore conducted his own research on the virus in order to create a super soldier drug. The scientist recruited Bera Jeza to help him the project. However, Jeza soon betrayed her employer and contacted [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to sell him the super soldier drug.<ref name="SWG:TP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Plan|Tatooine}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the laboratory in Mos Eisley was ravaged and the scientists [[Bera Jeza]] and [[Derg Prantis]] were [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]]. Because of the relationship between Bera Jeza and the [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate the murders.<ref name="SWG:BJE" /> Thanks to the help of the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Cale Herron]], the investigation eventually led to the discovery of the [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|Blackwing virus outbreak]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:ID">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Investigate Dathomir|Lok}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mos Eisley Biolab appeared as a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BJE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mos Eisley Biolab was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 13|Game Update 13]]", released on [[September 30]], [[2009]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1003113|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 13 -- Chronicle Master System}}</ref> This location was part of the questline "[[W:c:swg:Something is Obviously Wrong|Something is Obviously Wrong]],"<ref name="SWG:BJE" /> an introduction to the "[[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|Death Troopers]]" [[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|update]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
